candidate_requirements.requirement: Clarify the course and components of both cord structures (e.g., careful intraoperative dissection/identification, with specialist or second-surgeon assistance) before any division or ligation.
candidate_requirements.rationale: A mistaken anatomical assumption about a duplicated or split vas could cause irreversible harm; this is the key missing determination at the decision point.

candidate_requirements.deadline: As a proposed request in this written plan, to be executed before any structure is divided in the current/future procedure.
